criterion: Only raw SS_LOAD/TS_LOAD, each Event/native: strict <0.01 unrounded adjacent-window slope change and cross-process (max-min)/mean; each window R2>=.99; every point CV<=.05 and (P95-P5)/median<=.10. CONTROL and paired subtraction are diagnostic only.
limits: SS and TS are distinct source specializations. Resource differences, initialization and control modes remain explicit.
CONTROL skips the MMA loop: expected N slope approximately zero. Positive slope/R2 tests are not applicable; no zero-slope throughput is published.
The endpoint includes asynchronous completion and wait/poll, not just issue. Candidate throughput is conditional completed resident-stream service, not one-packet latency.
Strict convergence is admitted on raw LOAD Event/native only. Paired LOAD-minus-CONTROL is sensitivity, cannot rescue a failing raw gate and is not a physical lower/upper bound.
A faster TS result cannot replace the original SS QK rate or alone prove a physical SMEM bus width.
